Darden Restaurants is the largest full-service restaurant company in the world by revenue, and almost none of the work that makes it run happens inside a restaurant. Darden posted[$13.2 billion in revenue and $1.21 billion in net income in fiscal 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darden_Restaurants) , across ten brands: Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, Yard House, The Capital Grille, Seasons 52, Bahama Breeze, Eddie V's, Ruth's Chris Steak House and Chuy's, employing[191,105 people across 2,181 restaurants](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darden_Restaurants) . The number that matters to a student is in Darden's own intern job description: at the Restaurant Support Center in Orlando, approximately 1,000 team members provide the support the restaurant teams need. The internship is a full-time, 40-hour-a-week, 10-week summer program[paid at $20 per hour](https://jobs.jou.ufl.edu/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Darden-Internship.pdf) , and the posting is unusually blunt about the trade: individuals are responsible to provide their own housing and reliable transportation.

## What Is a Darden Restaurants Internship?


A Darden Restaurants internship is a paid, 10-week summer placement that puts college students into real roles at the Restaurant Support Center in Orlando, the single corporate office behind[$13.2 billion in annual revenue](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darden_Restaurants) and ten brands: Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, Yard House, The Capital Grille, Seasons 52, Bahama Breeze, Eddie V's, Ruth's Chris Steak House and Chuy's. The RSC employs approximately 1,000 team members and houses the Culinary, Marketing, Communications, Digital Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, HR, Legal and Business Intelligence functions. Interns are paid[$20 per hour](https://jobs.jou.ufl.edu/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Darden-Internship.pdf) , work 40-hour weeks, and receive paid holidays for Memorial Day and Independence Day plus dining discounts across all brands. The company, led by CEO Rick Cardenas, serves more than 410 million guests annually across more than 2,181 restaurants.


## When Do Darden Restaurants Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Darden does not publish a formal recruiting calendar, and its corporate careers page has no early-careers or campus-recruiting section. Based on the 2023-2024 cycle job descriptions, the summer internship starts in mid-May and runs 10 weeks through late July. Summer 2027 intern requisitions were not posted on the RSC board as of September 2026, and no prior-cycle open date could be established from any Darden source. The practical guidance is to check dardenrscjobs.recruiting.com directly and often, because there is no alert mechanism to join.

Summer 2027 intern postings are not live on the RSC board. Darden's corporate board at dardenrscjobs.recruiting.com had 16 open requisitions as of September 7, 2026, and none was an internship. Begin checking the board now and bookmark it.

ROLLING — APPLY WEEK 1


Summer 2027 intern requisitions are expected to post sometime between fall 2026 and early 2027. This is an inference from the mid-May start date, not a Darden statement. No application deadline has ever been published by this employer.


Mid-May 2027


Program starts. The 2024 cycle ran May 13 through July 19. Interns must commit to the full 10-week block and arrange their own housing and transportation in Orlando.


Late July 2027


Program ends with a formal work evaluation to assess strengths and areas of development. The evaluation is Darden's stated capstone, with the possibility of future career opportunities.


*How to read this page: our dates come from tracking previous recruiting cycles and daily posting data. Treat them as informed estimates based on historical patterns, not confirmed dates. The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Darden publishes no application deadline, which means you cannot plan around a close date. What you can plan around is the start date: mid-May, fixed. That means the postings have to go up months earlier, and rolling review is the default assumption for an employer that publishes no deadline. At $20 an hour with no housing stipend, the math matters: $8,000 gross for 10 weeks, before Orlando rent and a car. Students who work out the logistics before applying, not after accepting, are the ones who finish the program. Apply the day the posting appears, because you do not know when the class fills. And arrive with AP Style writing samples and a real Excel project, because two of the three verified JDs name those skills by name.

## Which Darden Restaurants Internship Programs Should You Target?


Darden offers corporate summer internships through its Restaurant Support Center in Orlando. The verified tracks are marketing-oriented, but the RSC also houses Finance, Supply Chain, IT, HR, Legal and Business Intelligence, and a Darden IT employee has confirmed on Reddit that IT hires summer interns.


Track Focus Duration Key details


Communication Intern Brand Communications (PR, influencer campaigns), Corporate Communications (financial, crisis, sustainability), Social Media (community engagement, content creation, guest recovery) 10 weeks Paid $20/hr; AP Style writing required; supports Darden's in-house communications agency


Digital Marketing Intern Data analysis, targeting strategies, audience performance reporting, Test & Learn planning, media vendor management 10 weeks Paid $20/hr; cross-functional work with Marketing and Finance; digital marketing campus org participation a plus


Brand Marketing Intern Food and Beverage Strategy, Communications, Data Analytics, Technology Enhancements; placed within a specific brand (Olive Garden, LongHorn, Ruth's Chris, Cheddar's, or Specialty Restaurant Group) 10 weeks Paid $20/hr; Brand Management or Culinary and Beverage Strategy placement; previous marketing experience a plus


Monitor the corporate board at[dardenrscjobs.recruiting.com](https://dardenrscjobs.recruiting.com/) for Summer 2027 postings. The eight brand career sites (olivegarden.com/careers, jobs.longhornsteakhouse.com, etc.) carry hourly restaurant roles, not corporate internships.


## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Darden states its eligibility requirements directly in its intern job descriptions, which is uncommon for a Fortune 500 employer. All three verified JDs carry the same two hard gates:


• **Class standing:** successful completion of three years of a related undergraduate degree program, effectively targeting rising seniors.


• **GPA:** minimum 3.0, stated identically in all three recovered intern JDs.


• **Major:** related undergraduate degree in Marketing (Brand Marketing track), Public Relations or Communications (Communication track), or a related field for Digital Marketing.


• **Availability:** must commit to a 10-week placement beginning mid-May. Full-time, 40 hours per week.


• **Location:** on-site at the Restaurant Support Center in Orlando, FL. Interns provide their own housing and reliable transportation.


### Does Darden Require Prior Marketing Experience?


Not strictly. The Brand Marketing JD lists previous marketing experience as a plus, and the Digital Marketing JD encourages active participation in a campus marketing organization. Neither is a hard requirement. What all three JDs do require is comfort interacting with restaurant teams and other key partners, which means prior restaurant, retail or hospitality work experience is directly relevant in a way it is not at most corporate internships.


## What Skills Does Darden Restaurants Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


Darden's intern hiring is marketing-centric across the three verified tracks, and the skill profile reflects that: project management, fast-paced collaboration and restaurant-team fluency appear in every JD, while analytical skills and digital marketing knowledge distinguish the more technical Digital Marketing track. The company names Excel as the only data tool and AP Style as the writing standard. No JD asks for SQL, Python, Tableau or any named analytics platform, which tells you the bar is practical judgment applied to real data, not technical tooling.

## What Is the Darden Restaurants Application and Interview Process Like?


Darden does not publish its intern interview process. The three recovered JDs describe the program but not the hiring loop, and no verifiable first-hand account of a Darden Restaurants corporate intern interview was found. What is known:


1. **Watch the RSC board at[dardenrscjobs.recruiting.com](https://dardenrscjobs.recruiting.com/) .** This is the only board carrying corporate internships. The eight brand career sites are hourly restaurant boards. There is no email alert or talent community to join.


2. **Apply through Paradox.** Every Apply Now button on the RSC board routes to Darden's Paradox (Olivia) application flow. The career site also runs the Olivia conversational assistant, which is configured for job search on the corporate careers page.


3. **Clear the two hard gates.** Every recovered JD requires completion of three years of a related undergraduate degree program and a minimum 3.0 GPA. These are stated, not implied.


4. **Interview format: not published.** No Darden source describes the intern interview stages, and Glassdoor data for this employer was unreachable (employer ID mismatch). Indeed has zero intern-filtered reviews.


5. **Start date is fixed.** The JDs require commitment to a 10-week block beginning mid-May (the 2024 cycle started May 13).


Because Darden publishes less about its process than most Fortune 500 peers, preparation should focus on the JD requirements themselves: AP Style writing samples, an Excel-based data project, and a genuine answer to why you want to work with one of their specific brands. ## How Do You Stand Out at a Company That Publishes Almost Nothing About Its Process?


Three moves, all executable before the postings go live. First, clear the two hard gates: 3.0 GPA and completion of three years of undergrad in a related field. If you do not meet both, this program is not open to you. Second, write in AP Style and prove it. Two of the three verified JDs name it explicitly, and a cover letter with obvious AP violations is a self-inflicted wound. Third, name the brand you want. The Brand Marketing JD places interns within a specific brand: Olive Garden, LongHorn, Ruth's Chris, Cheddar's, or the Specialty Restaurant Group, in either Brand Management or Culinary and Beverage Strategy. Knowing that structure and having a reasoned preference separates you from applicants who think they are applying to one generic restaurant company. And remember: at $20 an hour with no housing stipend, the Orlando logistics are part of the application decision. Work out rent and transportation before you apply, not after you accept.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Darden Restaurants internship?


No. The summer 2026 program has already run. The 2024 cycle ran May 13 through July 19, and the 2026 cycle followed the same pattern. The next opportunity is summer 2027: no postings are live as of September 2026, but the RSC board at dardenrscjobs.recruiting.com is the only place they will appear.


### How much do Darden interns get paid?


Darden's own intern job descriptions from the 2023-2024 cycle state interns are paid $20 per hour for a full-time 40-hour week across 10 weeks, roughly $8,000 gross for the program. Darden has published no rate for the Summer 2027 cycle, so treat $20 as the last confirmed figure. Benefits include paid holidays for Memorial Day and Independence Day and dining discounts across all ten brands.


### Does Darden provide housing for interns?


No. The job description is explicit: individuals are responsible to provide their own housing and reliable transportation to and from work during the internship experience. No housing stipend and no relocation support appears in any Darden intern posting. At $20 per hour, the $8,000 gross covers less than you think in Orlando rent and a car.


### What GPA do I need for a Darden internship?


All three recovered Darden intern job descriptions state minimum 3.0 GPA, alongside successful completion of three years of a related undergraduate degree program, which effectively targets rising seniors. This is a hard gate, not a preference.


### Where are Darden internships located?


The Restaurant Support Center at 1000 Darden Center Drive, Orlando, Florida. All 16 open corporate requisitions carry the same address. No remote or hybrid intern option appears in any Darden posting, and the JD's requirement for reliable transportation confirms daily on-site commuting.


### What kinds of Darden internships exist?


Three verified tracks from recovered JDs: Communication Intern, Digital Marketing Intern and Brand Marketing Intern. The Brand Marketing track places interns within a specific brand: Olive Garden, LongHorn, Ruth's Chris, Cheddar's, or the Specialty Restaurant Group. A Darden IT employee has also confirmed on Reddit that IT hires summer interns. The RSC houses Culinary, HR, Supply Chain, Finance, Real Estate, Legal and Business Intelligence, but no intern JDs for those functions were found.


### Does Darden sponsor work visas for interns?


Not stated. Darden publishes no intern visa-sponsorship position on its careers pages, its job board, or in any of the three intern job descriptions. International students should ask the recruiter directly rather than assuming either answer.


### Is the dress code at the Darden RSC formal?


No. Darden's own posting says RSC employees are welcome to wear casual attire every day of the week, including jeans, capris, T-shirts and athletic shoes. Business casual may be required for certain occasions. This is unusually informal for a Fortune 500 corporate headquarters.


Darden's RSC internship is a defined, modestly paid, geographically fixed program at the world's largest full-service restaurant company. The postings are not live yet.
